tools.name: uoink_video
tools.description: Extract a single YouTube video into a Uoink corpus. Returns the saved folder, markdown corpus, and screenshot paths.
tools.title: Capture video

tools.name: uoink_playlist
tools.description: Start asynchronous extraction for a YouTube playlist.
tools.title: Capture playlist

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Return the full status object for an async Uoink job.
tools.title: Get job status

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel an async Uoink job and leave partial outputs on disk.
tools.title: Cancel job

tools.name: list_recent_uoinks
tools.description: List recent saved Uoink corpora.
tools.title: List recent captures

tools.name: search_uoinks
tools.description: Full-text search across saved Uoink corpora.

mode.description: Auto uses hybrid when the local semantic index is ready, otherwise keyword.

match.description: Forgiving matches useful words; strict requires every word.

channel.description: Filter results to one channel. Optional.

hook_type.description: Filter results to one hook type. Optional.

tools.title: Search captures

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Full-text search over transcript windows from saved uoinks. Long source cues retain coarse timing and link to the cue start in the source. Use this to find the exact quotable passage; use search_uoinks to find whole items.

mode.description: Auto uses hybrid when the local semantic index is ready, otherwise keyword.

match.description: Forgiving matches useful words; strict requires every word.

video_id.description: Restrict results to one item by video_id. Optional.

channel.description: Filter results to one channel. Optional.

tools.title: Search transcript clips

tools.name: get_evidence_card
tools.description: Return an evidence card for one saved uoink: title, channel, platform, topic, source URL, a short summary hint, and its most quotable clips spread across the timeline, each with a deep link. Resolve by slug or video_id.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Get evidence card

tools.name: get_uoink_corpus
tools.description: Return the full markdown corpus for a saved uoink by slug.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Get saved corpus

tools.name: analyze_comments
tools.description: Run Comment Intelligence on an existing uoink and return themes, mentioned products/tools, and disagreements.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Analyze comments

tools.name: classify_hook
tools.description: Classify the hook type for an existing uoink.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Classify hook

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Return captured Hook Type taxonomy rows, optionally filtered by channel and hook_type.

channel.description: Exact channel name to filter by. Optional.

hook_type.description: Hook type to filter by. Optional.

tools.title: Get hook taxonomy

tools.name: get_citation_map
tools.description: Return the transcript + screenshot citation map for a saved uoink, each entry with a timestamped YouTube deep link.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Get citation map

tools.name: get_uoink_health
tools.description: Return the per-section extraction health score for a saved uoink.

slug.description: Folder slug of the saved uoink.

tools.title: Get capture health

tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: Find every place an entity (person, tool, product, company, or topic) is mentioned across saved uoinks. Rank by name match, with newest first for ties. Results include stored timestamps and source links.

match.description: Forgiving matches entity name words; strict requires the exact normalized name.

tools.title: Find entity mentions

tools.name: get_transcript_reliability
tools.description: Return stored transcript reliability spans for a saved uoink by YouTube video_id. Read-only; computation is triggered by the helper endpoint or the user's auto-check setting.

video_id.description: YouTube video ID for the saved uoink.

tools.title: Get transcript reliability

tools.name: add_podcast_feed
tools.description: Register an RSS feed URL. Idempotent -- existing URL returns the same row. poll_interval_min default 60, range 15-1440. Metadata is watched automatically; auto_ingest is an explicit per-feed opt-in and defaults false.
tools.title: Add podcast feed

tools.name: list_podcast_feeds
tools.description: List registered RSS feeds newest-first.
tools.title: List podcast feeds

tools.name: remove_podcast_feed
tools.description: Delete a feed + cascade its episodes.
tools.title: Remove podcast feed

tools.name: poll_podcast_feed
tools.description: Trigger one feed poll (HTTP GET + RSS/Atom parse + upsert episodes). Conditional GET via ETag/If-Modified-Since on subsequent polls so daily-news podcasts don't re-download an unchanged feed body.
tools.title: Poll podcast feed

tools.name: list_podcast_episodes
tools.description: List episodes. Optional feed_id + status filters (new | queued | downloaded | transcribed | ignored). Newest published first.
tools.title: List podcast episodes

tools.name: download_podcast_episode
tools.description: Download an episode's MP3 via yt-dlp + ffmpeg. Synchronous. Returns when the file lands at <data_root>/Podcasts/<feed-slug>/<episode-slug>.mp3 or yt-dlp errors. Idempotent -- skips re-download when the canonical path already has a non-zero file.
tools.title: Download podcast audio

tools.name: get_whisperx_status
tools.description: Report whether the WhisperX runtime is importable + the currently-selected model size + the diarization default. Agents call this before transcribe to decide whether to surface an install prompt to the user.
tools.title: Get transcription status

tools.name: transcribe_podcast_episode
tools.description: Queue WhisperX for a downloaded episode. A single below-normal-priority worker writes the JSON transcript next to the MP3; get_job_status reports durable progress. Returns consent_required=True when the first-time model download (200 MB - 2 GB) needs the user to opt in (re-issue with consent_given=True after the dashboard prompt records the opt-in), OR a runtime-not-installed error when whisperx isn't importable.
tools.title: Transcribe podcast episode

tools.name: episode_to_corpus
tools.description: Publish a completed podcast transcript into the local Uoink corpus. Writes deterministic Markdown and sidecar files, indexes full text and source-aware citations, and safely repairs partial prior attempts.
tools.title: Publish podcast corpus

tools.name: get_library_activity
tools.description: Report deterministic library activity, shelf churn, and source observations.

start.description: Gregorian UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ

end.description: Gregorian UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ

tools.title: Get library activity

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Bounded clip-first search of the saved library (default 5, at most 20 hits) with verified clip or item-text passages when available. Check passage_verified before quoting; citation_reason explains missing passages. Each hit carries the item id, source revision, safe title and link, evidence kind and timing, a 240-character preview and revision-bound card and excerpt URIs for read_library_resource. Results are bounded, not exhaustive; follow next_step when more retrieval is needed.

mode.description: Auto uses hybrid when the local semantic index is ready, otherwise keyword.

match.description: Forgiving matches useful words; strict requires every word.

tools.title: Search library

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description: Resolve one saved item by video_id or slug (exactly one) and return its default Librarian evidence card unchanged plus canonical card, excerpt and initial corpus-chunk URIs. Bounded; use before quoting.
tools.title: Get library item

tools.name: read_library_resource
tools.description: Read one uoink://library/v1/ resource URI (card, excerpt, corpus chunk, shelf page or brief) with the same validation, contents and refusals as resources/read. Fallback for clients without native resource reads; identical text, one renderer.
tools.title: Read library resource

tools.name: get_playbook_input
tools.description: Prepare a bounded, cited research packet from the local library for outlier-posts, transcript-intel, comment-mining, creator-teardown or repurpose-pack. Returns instruction, packet and packet_hash; the client writes the report. No model, network, capture or settings changes.

arguments.description: The selected playbook's prompt arguments, with string values. Pass video_ids and kinds as comma-separated strings.

tools.title: Prepare research playbook input

tools.name: discover_candidates
tools.description: Plan or run one ScrapeCreators discovery search with your saved key. Off by default. Omit confirm_credits for a free plan; set it to the planned credits to spend. Requires discovery enabled, room under the daily cap, and agent discovery enabled or a dashboard intent. Saves normalized candidates locally; does not capture them or fetch thumbnails.
tools.title: Discover capture candidates

tools.name: queue_discovered
tools.description: Queue 1-10 saved discovery candidates for normal Uoink capture. Requires agent discovery enabled or a dashboard intent. Skips captured, queued, unsupported and unknown picks. No ScrapeCreators call or credits; the normal retry worker captures the selected URLs.
tools.title: Queue discovered posts

tools.name: get_library_brief_input
tools.description: Prepare bounded input for a client-run daily brief: for a UTC date and a Phase 2 run id, return job_key, input_hash, bound queue/run/projection revisions, capture and event counts, coverage, up to 20 work-status rows and up to 5 default Librarian cards (at most 24,576 bytes). Read only: no lease, no mutation. The client tracks its own report job.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD; not in the future.

tools.title: Prepare library brief input

tools.name: publish_library_brief
tools.description: Local write: persist one client-produced brief for a job prepared by get_library_brief_input. Validates the packet against current library data (stale_brief on change), binds every citation to supplied evidence, is idempotent on submission_key, and stores an immutable artifact under the local reach/briefs directory. Cannot apply labels or alter the assignment queue. Invoke only as part of the user's requested brief job.

input_packet.description: The exact packet returned by get_library_brief_input.

submission_key.description: Client idempotency key (1-200 characters, no whitespace).

document.description: The brief, at most 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

citations.description: At most 20 citations: item_id, source_revision, card_hash, excerpt_id, quote (1-500 code points), evidence_kind, start, end.

usage.description: Client-reported usage, or null when unavailable (never zero).

tools.title: Publish library brief

tools.name: export_cited_range
tools.description: Read-only cited export of one stored transcript range (exact cue-aligned start/end, at most 120 s and 200 cues) or one current excerpt id from a saved item: verbatim stored text, per-cue speaker labels with provenance, overlapping chapters, safe source and seek links, source/media revisions and evidence refs. Nothing is fetched, transcribed or saved; refusals carry a next_step.

start.description: Range start in seconds; must equal the first selected cue's start (with end).

end.description: Range end in seconds; must equal the last selected cue's end (with start).

excerpt_id.description: A current excerpt id (instead of start/end).

source_revision.description: Optional pin; refuses revision_unavailable on change.

media_revision.description: Optional pin; refuses revision_unavailable on change.

tools.title: Export cited transcript range

tools.name: list_library_work
tools.description: List Librarian assignment work for a run: counts by work state and manifest disposition, the run revision, one cursor page of items, and whether staged work is waiting for a subscribed client. Expires stale leases while listing; the server never runs the Librarian itself.
tools.title: List library work

tools.name: claim_library_work
tools.description: Lease Librarian work for a client (action=claim returns up to twelve single-item packets, each with one evidence card and an attempt token), or renew, release or cancel the client's own current attempt. Leases run 60-900 seconds and never past one hour after the first claim; a row is exhausted after three.
tools.title: Claim library work

tools.name: submit_library_result
tools.description: Submit one Librarian result for one leased work row: an assignment of one to three shelf memberships with quoted evidence, or an explicit unmapped, unsupported or error outcome. Validated and stored; nothing is applied to current labels. An identical retry under the same submission_key returns the recorded response.
tools.title: Submit library result

tools.name: apply_reshelving
tools.description: Preview the exact reshelving delta for a run (mode=preview, the default), or apply a locally approved, unexpired preview by its delta hash and operation key (mode=apply). Apply is refused while librarian_apply_enabled is off, which is the shipping default, and stops at 15 percent churn without a trusted human approval.
tools.title: Apply reshelving

tools.name: pin_shelf
tools.description: Pin, unpin or move one item on a shelf as a user decision that the Librarian may not override. Requires a user_intent_token minted by the dashboard confirmation route; no client actor string grants that authority.
tools.title: Pin library shelf

tools.name: undo_library_apply
tools.description: Undo one recorded library apply by replaying its stored inverse as a new, itself reversible, journal operation. Only the apply that produced the current projection revision can be undone, and a user_intent_token from the dashboard is required.
tools.title: Undo library apply

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List standing sources (podcast RSS feeds, YouTube channels and playlists) with consent state, enrollment, today's UTC start allowance and detection health. Read-only; keyset pagination.
tools.title: List standing sources

tools.name: register_source
tools.description: Register a standing source for metadata detection only. Creates the source with capture off and a due detection cursor; no network call, no capture. A duplicate returns the existing source unchanged (created=false).
tools.title: Register standing source

tools.name: source_status
tools.description: One source's current summary, one page of observed items with capture and classification state, and every in-flight reservation. Read-only: never enrolls, polls or starts work.
tools.title: Get source status

tools.name: set_source_consent
tools.description: Turn standing capture on or off for one source. Requires the expected source revision (and cursor revision when enabling), an operation key and a user_intent_token minted by the local dashboard confirmation; the stored receipt is returned on an identical retry. On: at most 25 back-catalog items once, then new items, 10 starts per UTC day. Off: releases unstarted reservations.
tools.title: Set source consent

tools.name: analyze_self_channel
tools.description: Aggregate the user's own saved videos (those tagged is_self via channel-name recognition) into hook evolution, format evolution, performance trend by month, and a top-performers list. Pass `handle` to scope to one of the user's registered channels; omit for the union across every registered channel. `limit` caps the top_performers list (default 10, max 100). Pure local read.

handle.description: User channel handle (with or without @). Optional.

tools.title: Analyze own channel

tools.name: get_schema_version
tools.description: Report the data-shape versions Uoink writes + the supported read-range. v2.5 substrate: cross-version aggregators (Channel Decoder, Niche Corpus) check this before assuming v2 fields are present in older rows/sidecars. Read-only, no arguments.
tools.title: Get storage schema version

tools.name: get_user_role
tools.description: Report the user's persisted role (creator | researcher | marketer | mixed) + the dashboard emphasis (primary/secondary chip order + default sort) the helper computes from it. Read-only.
tools.title: Get user role

tools.name: set_user_role
tools.description: Persist the user's role choice. Drives Library default sort + filter-chip emphasis on the dashboard. Bounded enum -- one of creator | researcher | marketer | mixed.
tools.title: Set user role

tools.name: check_live_status
tools.description: Probe a URL to find out if it is a live broadcast without extracting. Returns one of: not_live | live | upcoming | post_live | was_live. The agent uses this to decide between immediate extraction and 'wait until the broadcast ends' (the helper's live_stream_behavior setting handles the latter for /extract; this tool is the read-only probe path).
tools.title: Check live video status

tools.name: add_monitored_playlist
tools.description: Register a YouTube playlist URL to monitor for auto-uoinks. Idempotent on UNIQUE playlist_url. poll_interval_min default 5, range 1-1440.
tools.title: Add monitored playlist

tools.name: list_monitored_playlists
tools.description: List registered playlists newest-first.
tools.title: List monitored playlists

tools.name: remove_monitored_playlist
tools.description: Delete a playlist + cascade its discovery events.
tools.title: Remove monitored playlist

tools.name: poll_monitored_playlist
tools.description: Poll one playlist (yt-dlp --flat-playlist) + diff against last_seen_video_ids + auto-queue new videos via the existing pending_yoinks retry worker. Returns the new[] discovery list so the dashboard can show it under a 'from mobile playlist' label distinct from rate-limit retries.
tools.title: Poll monitored playlist

tools.name: list_monitored_playlist_events
tools.description: List per-discovery events. Optional filters: playlist_id, status (discovered | queued | extracted | failed). Newest first.
tools.title: List playlist events

tools.name: get_user_taste
tools.description: Return the consolidated TASTE.md (preferred hooks/formats, avoid list, top performance anchors). Generated from engagement events + persisted taste anchors. Read-only, no arguments.
tools.title: Get taste memory

tools.name: get_user_memory
tools.description: Return the user's free-form USER.md notes (Channels I admire, My channel(s), Topics, Workflow notes). Hand-edited markdown -- the consolidator never overwrites this file. No arguments.
tools.title: Get user memory

tools.name: update_user_taste
tools.description: Set one taste anchor section (preferred_hooks | preferred_formats | avoid) and re-consolidate TASTE.md. `content` is markdown that replaces the section body verbatim -- bullets recommended.
tools.title: Update taste memory

tools.name: get_engagement_signal
tools.description: Return the time-decayed value_score for one video plus per-event-type counts and last event timestamp. Events live entirely on the local SQLite index (zero outbound). Weights are documented in index.py (_ENGAGEMENT_WEIGHTS); decay half-life is 30 days.
tools.title: Get engagement signal

tools.name: classify_facets
tools.description: Persist agent-classified facets + free-form tags for a video. Model-agnostic: the calling agent does the LLM work using its own model; this tool validates against bounded enums and writes to the row. The server fills performance_tier (channel-relative) and length_bucket (from duration) if you don't pass them.
tools.title: Classify item facets

tools.name: query_by_facets
tools.description: Filter saved yoinks by facet values (format / performance_tier / hook_type / topic / length_bucket / tag). All filters AND-combined; newest first.
tools.title: Query item facets

tools.name: get_facet_taxonomy
tools.description: Enum lists for the v2.5 facet axes (used for filter chips).
tools.title: Get facet taxonomy

tools.name: assemble_workspace
tools.description: v3 P4 build workspace: pull a corpus slice for planning a video. Ranks yoinks by S1 facets (format match), performance tier (over > average > under), and S2 engagement value_score. Returns the slice + audience questions from comments + optional self-channel snapshot (if your_channel is set) + optional taste anchors (if S4 memory layer is available). Pure local read; the calling agent does any LLM analysis downstream. If `workspace_id` is provided the slice is persisted onto that row.
tools.title: Assemble workspace

tools.name: critique_against_corpus
tools.description: v3 P4 critique tool. Two-phase: call WITHOUT `findings` to retrieve the assembled context (corpus slice + audience questions + taste anchors) -- the agent does the LLM analysis on that context. Call WITH `findings` (structured JSON object with hook_strength, structural_deviation, pacing_issues, missing_audience_hooks per ROADMAP P4) to persist the analysis to the workspace's critique log. Model-agnostic default; BYO-key mode accepted but not yet implemented on-server.
tools.title: Critique against corpus

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: v3 P4: list build workspaces newest-first. Read-only.
tools.title: List workspaces

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: v3 P4: fetch one workspace + its full critique log (every draft + findings combination the agent has persisted).
tools.title: Get workspace

tools.name: extract_claims
tools.description: v3 A2 (Loki-inspired): persist agent-extracted claims for a video. LOCKED FRAMING -- the calling agent does the LLM decomposition; this tool validates + writes. Each claim is {claim_text, check_worthiness? (0.0-1.0), context?}. NEVER auto-asserts truth verdicts -- surfaces checkable claims so the user can decide which to verify.
tools.title: Extract claims

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: v3 A2: record evidence for one extracted claim. alignment_signal MUST be one of supports / contradicts / mixed / inconclusive. NEVER 'true' / 'false' / 'lie'. The user judges the verdict from the surfaced evidence.

evidence.description: Each: {source_url, quote, alignment_signal}. alignment_signal enum is locked.

tools.title: Record claim evidence

tools.name: list_claims
tools.description: v3 A2: list extracted claims. Filter by video_id and/or status (extracted | verified | not-attempted).
tools.title: List claims

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: v3 A2: fetch one claim by id, with stored evidence.
tools.title: Get claim

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: v3 P5 script studio: two-phase generator. Call WITHOUT `script` payload to retrieve grounding context (workspace metadata + assembled corpus slice + audience questions + optional taste anchors + optional self-channel snapshot). The calling agent does the writing using its own model. Call WITH `script` (a structured object with hook + beats + body + cta + source_yoinks citations) to persist as a new versioned row. parent_script_id chains revisions. An optional hook_type_lens biases the opening toward one of the 9 hook styles.

hook_type_lens.description: Optional hook lens that biases the script's opening toward that style (generation intent).

tools.title: Generate script

tools.name: revise_script
tools.description: v3 P5: revise an existing script grounded in critique findings. Two-phase like generate_script -- without `revised_script` returns previous + grounding for the agent to act on; with `revised_script` persists as a new version (parent_script_id auto-set to the prior id).
tools.title: Revise script

tools.name: get_shot_list
tools.description: v3 P5: derive (and persist) a default shot list from a script's beats + the parent workspace's S1 format facet. Per-beat row with format-specific cue suggestions. The calling agent can override by supplying shot_list directly in generate_script.
tools.title: Generate shot list

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: v3 P5: list scripts newest-first. Optional workspace_id filter scopes to one workspace's history.
tools.title: List scripts

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: v3 P5: fetch one script by id.
tools.title: Get script

tools.name: write_tweet
tools.description: Two-phase tweet/thread generator. Phase 1 (no `body`) returns grounding (source yoink + creator credit + style anchors + Voice DNA prompt). Phase 2 (`body` present) persists + scans for canned phrases + returns structured warnings (soft warn -- NEVER auto-blocks). Creator credit is required in the body.

generate.description: When true and body is absent, generate directly with the saved Anthropic key.

compute_mode.description: Use byo_key to request direct generation.

output_mode.description: Composer output mode. thread prompts a thread while persisting a tweet-kind piece (the composer splits the body).

hook_type_lens.description: Optional hook lens that biases the opening toward that style (generation intent).

tools.title: Write tweet or thread

tools.name: write_blog
tools.description: Two-phase blog generator. Same shape as write_tweet but Phase 2 accepts title, dek, tags, and expects markdown body with a Source section. Soft-warn canned-phrase scan; creator credit non-suppressible.

generate.description: When true and body is absent, generate directly with the saved Anthropic key.

compute_mode.description: Use byo_key to request direct generation.

hook_type_lens.description: Optional hook lens that biases the opening toward that style (generation intent).

tools.title: Write blog

tools.name: list_writing_pieces
tools.description: List generated pieces newest-first. Optional `kind` (tweet|thread|blog) + `yoink_id` filters.
tools.title: List writing pieces

tools.name: get_writing_piece
tools.description: Fetch one piece by id.
tools.title: Get writing piece

tools.name: add_style_anchor
tools.description: Add a Substack-style voice anchor (URL or raw pasted text). User names each. Cap at 10 -- returns 422-shaped error when exceeded. URL ingestion extracts prose via the helper's page extractor (Universal Site PR); falls back to NULL raw_text when the extractor isn't bound yet.
tools.title: Add style anchor

tools.name: list_style_anchors
tools.description: List style anchors + their active flag + the helper's 10-anchor cap.
tools.title: List style anchors

tools.name: remove_style_anchor
tools.description: Delete a style anchor.
tools.title: Remove style anchor

tools.name: uoink_url
tools.description: Capture any http(s) URL through the helper's universal extractor. Known video platforms use the full media pipeline; other sites use the metadata and transcript fallback.
tools.title: Capture URL

tools.name: uoink_note
tools.description: Save a text note as a first-class local corpus item.
tools.title: Save note

tools.name: uoink_image
tools.description: Save a base64 PNG, JPEG, or WebP as a local image corpus item. No cloud OCR or vision service runs.
tools.title: Save image

tools.name: uoink_x
tools.description: Capture an X post and the author's earlier chain as a local corpus item. Requires x_text_capture_enabled, which defaults on.
tools.title: Capture X post

tools.name: uoink_page
tools.description: Capture an allowed page as a yoink. Crawl4AI runs ON-DEVICE when available (JS render + screenshot); stdlib fallback otherwise (static HTML + markdown synthesis, no screenshot). Allowlist-gated -- add the host via add_allowed_site first if it's not in the defaults (youtube.com, youtu.be, x.com, twitter.com). Result auto-persists as a yoink with source_type='page'.
tools.title: Capture web page

tools.name: uoink_reddit_thread
tools.description: Fetch a thread via its public .json (no API key, no OAuth), flatten the comment tree with a depth limit and a score threshold, and persist it as a yoink with source_type='reddit_thread'. Renders as Post -> Top comments -> nested replies so search and facets work on the conversation. Runs on-device; no allowlist gate.

depth_limit.description: How many reply levels to keep.

tools.title: Capture Reddit thread

tools.name: list_allowed_sites
tools.description: List the user's allowed hostnames. Default seeds (youtube.com, youtu.be, x.com, twitter.com) are pre-added by migration 0015 and removable like any other entry.
tools.title: List allowed sites

tools.name: add_allowed_site
tools.description: Add a hostname or wildcard pattern (`*.docs.example.com` matches all sub.docs.example.com subdomains). Idempotent on UNIQUE url_pattern. Plain hostnames also match their subdomains (so 'example.com' matches 'www.example.com').
tools.title: Add allowed site

tools.name: remove_allowed_site
tools.description: Remove a hostname or wildcard pattern from the allowlist.
tools.title: Remove allowed site

stdio_initialize.instructions: Uoink turns videos, playlists, and podcast episodes into local AI-ready corpora. Use the tools to capture, transcribe, publish, search, inspect, and analyze saved uoinks.

resourceTemplates.name: library-card
resourceTemplates.description: The default Librarian evidence card of one saved item: at most six excerpts of 240 characters inside the untrusted-evidence fence. item_key is unpadded base64url of the item id; source_revision, selection and card_hash are the bindings returned by discovery.

resourceTemplates.name: library-excerpt
resourceTemplates.description: One original excerpt of a saved item, untruncated up to 2,000 code points, bound to the item's source revision. excerpt_id is the card builder's excerpt identity returned by cards and search hits.

resourceTemplates.name: library-corpus-chunk
resourceTemplates.description: A bounded chunk of the stored corpus file as a reading aid: offset is a UTF-8 boundary byte offset, length 1-8192 source bytes (4096 suggested). corpus_revision is SHA-256 of the whole file.

resourceTemplates.name: library-shelf-page
resourceTemplates.description: A shelf definition and one page of up to 20 current members sorted by item id. offset is a member ordinal; the three revisions bind the taxonomy, the Phase 2 projection and the membership snapshot.

resourceTemplates.name: library-brief
resourceTemplates.description: One persisted client-produced daily brief for a UTC date, bound by its brief_hash (the publish_library_brief receipt). Unavailable as soon as a cited or sampled item is deleted or changes.

prompts.name: consult-library
prompts.description: Answer a question from cited library evidence: up to 5 bounded excerpt previews for a topic with revision-bound follow-up URIs.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Topic or question to look up (at most 512 characters).

prompts.name: evidence-brief
prompts.description: Compose a citable brief from up to 5 bounded Librarian cards on a topic, optionally limited to items captured on or after a UTC date.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Topic of the brief (at most 512 characters).

arguments.name: since
arguments.description: UTC capture date YYYY-MM-DD; only items captured on or after it.

prompts.name: whats-new
prompts.description: Deterministic counts and up to 20 recorded events (captures, shelf revisions, applied membership changes) for the last N days.
